name: Turkey Creek Nature Trail and Pavilion
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: 340 John Sims Parkway West, Niceville, FL 32578
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Walk the shaded mile-long boardwalk above Turkey Creek, climb down a swim-hole ladder and drift back toward the pavilion, or launch a kayak, canoe or tube (no gas engines). Turtles, ducks and wading birds are common. The north entrance on West College Boulevard has a kayak/canoe launch slip and picnic pavilions.
access: Park listed open 7 days, 6 a.m.-6 p.m.; walkway opens 6:30 a.m. and closes 20 minutes before park closing. Closed 6 a.m.-noon for maintenance on Mondays Nov 16, Nov 30 and Dec 14, 2026. No pets, no jumping or diving from the walkway, no food past the pavilion. Bring your own tube or boat (none rented on site found).

conditions.summary: City page lists normal hours and its 2026 maintenance closures (Nov 16 and Nov 30 mornings fall in the trip window). Niceville's Hurricane Isaias recovery page covers debris pickup only and lists no park closure. Niceville is close to the Isaias landfall, so a quick call (850-685-9405) is worthwhile. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

name: East Tower Hunt Camp (Osceola National Forest)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Year-round primitive camp, open 24 hours, used mainly as a hunt camp during general gun season. Portable toilets are listed 'during hunting season', which covers this trip.
access: No reservation needed. Stay limit: 14 days per month (National Forests in Florida) Forest Service: 'General gun season runs from mid-November to early January' and all camping is then restricted to designated hunt camps and Ocean Pond Campground. Derived from rule text (opens 7 days after the first day of Zone C antlered deer season, closes 57 days later) and FWC's 2026-27 Zone C start of Nov 7: about Nov 14, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027; the 2026-27 brochure itself was not retrieved. Roadside dispersed camping in Osceola NF is therefore not legal on Nov 21 - Dec 8. Forest Service urges hikers to wear bright colors.
